tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: The newest AI Today posts, newest first: title, key points, summary, canonical article url, source links, evidence level. Optional topic and kind.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Full-text search over AI Today posts (title, key points, text, tags), newest first, optionally within a topic and a date range. Same fields as latest_news.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The topics of AI Today with the number of published posts and the address of each topic page.

tools.name: news_ticker
tools.description: The day's most important headlines as ultra-short lines (the ticker of the site), with the canonical url of each article. Default today (Vienna time).

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One post in full: title, key points, summary, full text, tags, evidence level, every source with publisher and link, pictures, canonical url.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_news, list_categories, get_article · Public sink: get_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_news, list_categories, get_article · Public sink: get_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
